procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh conversation. I verified the explicitly supplied file hashes and byte counts and read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, helper source files and five native-evidence manifests without opening their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source_assets or protected_layouts, so their procedure arrays are empty. I used five functions.exec viewing batches in packet order M1, M2, M3, M4, M5. Each batch awaited three tools.view_image calls in native, usage720, thumbnail320 order with detail:'original', and emitted each returned image using image(...,'original'), for fifteen actual image-view calls. I visually inspected all fifteen returned images before retaining the first transcription readings, assigning any image scores or judging set diversity. No revisit was used. PNG headers independently verified native dimensions and RGB color type 2 without tRNS; no image was resized or edited by me. The runner's session/thread identity is not observable to me and is left null; no trace-derived assertion is made.

evidence.location: upper-right information block and lower-left participation block
evidence.observation: The event name, date, time and venue are dark on the pale tabletop. The bring-one/change-one instruction, activity description, free-entry line and invitation remain readable without zooming.

evidence.location: whole photographic composition
evidence.observation: The two hand-and-object encounters give the repair/exchange purpose a specific human form. A pale tabletop, restrained orange emphasis and close contact with ordinary used objects communicate patient, approachable participation.

evidence.location: whole composition relative to M2–M5
evidence.observation: The title sits midway down the left side, logistics at upper right and participation at lower left, within one continuous photographic tabletop. This differs from M2's central banner, M3's sewn textile field, M4's object grid/footer title and M5's framed narrative panels.

evidence.location: upper-left clothing repair and lower-right book between hands
evidence.observation: Hands work at the frayed edge of a striped garment; another pair of hands meets on a visibly worn book. These are large, legible repair and transfer subjects, occupying the composition rather than small decorative marks.

evidence.location: upper-left clothing repair and lower-right book between hands

content_form.location: upper-left frayed striped garment
content_form.observation: Visible thread, a button, fabric wear and fingers working at the garment edge communicate an actual small repair rather than merely displaying sewing equipment.

content_form.location: lower-right book and two hands entering from different edges
content_form.observation: The shared grip on the worn book supplies a readable object-transfer relationship. Together with the garment action it specifically joins both halves of the repair/exchange brief; no claim about unseen identities or the direction of transfer is needed.

hierarchy.location: upper-right event/date/time/venue block
hierarchy.observation: The four short lines form an easily scanned practical-information unit. The event is identified before the reader needs to decode the surrounding photograph.

hierarchy.location: orange title at middle left and orange invitation at lower left
hierarchy.observation: Color connects the title and invitation across the page. The title is displaced from the top, so the sequence is less linear, but the separated black logistics and lower participation text still remain distinct.

typography.location: middle-left two-line title and upper-right logistics
typography.observation: Intact Hangul, deliberate word spaces and a soft title wrap after '더' survive in the first reading. Date dots, time colons and the range dash are visible.

typography.location: lower-left four-line participation group
typography.observation: The smaller activity line stays legible on the light tabletop; the two orange lines use larger weight/size without displacing the supplied body copy.

space.location: open tabletop between the two cropped actions
space.observation: The large pale center gives the offset title room while the upper-left garment and lower-right book make a diagonal relationship across it.

space.location: right information block and left lower copy margins
space.observation: Practical text occupies clear tabletop areas with consistent inset edges. No hand, book edge or thread crosses the required text.

image_material.location: striped garment cuff, thread and book cover
image_material.observation: Fabric stripe direction, frayed fibers, button holes, book corners and page block are locally legible; grayscale lighting holds both material subjects in one tabletop setting.

image_material.location: hands at top and bottom of the photograph
image_material.observation: Visible finger joints and contact shadows make the object grips coherent. The tight crops reduce context but do not conceal the repair subject or the book contact.

emotion_control.location: hands and worn everyday objects
emotion_control.observation: The close, careful hand work and shared contact with a used book convey care rather than urgency. Wear is presented as something worth keeping.

emotion_control.location: orange title and closing invitation
emotion_control.observation: The warm emphasis on '천천히 들러요' supports the client's low-pressure invitation while the dark practical copy remains straightforward.

procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic conversation, verified the supplied file byte counts and SHA-256 pins and read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, summarize.py, run_agent.py and all five native-evidence manifests. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so those prerequisite lists are empty. Then used tools.view_image with detail="original", forwarding each returned image through functions.exec. Five consecutive member batches visually presented and were inspected in packet order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. Each view call was awaited in its member loop. All 15 exact poster images were visually inspected before the first transcription judgment, any image score or diversity score. No image revisit was needed or performed. Actual PNG dimensions, RGB color type and absence of tRNS transparency were subsequently verified by reading PNG headers/chunks; no image was generated, resized or edited. No peer review, unpinned manifest target, maker inspection, credential, other round or additional plan was read. No agent was spawned, forked or resumed. typography.location: central white event name on cobalt field

typography.location: upper-left title/logistics and lower-right instruction heading

space.location: blue diagonal bands separating white wedges

space.location: bottom-left fee/invitation and bottom-right instruction block

image_material.location: lower sweater collar, patch, folded layers and hands

emotion_control.location: opposing hands and central blue event band

emotion_control.location: patched sweater and lower-left invitation

ai_slop.observation: The two large object transfers have distinct content roles. There is no random icon filler, fabricated branding or extra copy; color and contours stay within a coherent small vocabulary.

ai_slop.location: book pages, sweater stitch paths and cuff marks

content_form.observation: Large stitches bridge the visibly worn boundary and torn/open weave, directly expressing keeping fabric in use through repair.

content_form.location: lower-left/center square cloth patch
content_form.observation: The separately attached patch and its stitches provide a second specific repair construction. Exchange has no depicted transfer here and relies on the explicit event/activity wording, which limits breadth but not basic communication.

hierarchy.location: top headline/subtitle and right-side logistics
hierarchy.observation: The serif headline and smaller bold event line establish a clear opening; the three-line date/time/venue group is isolated below, making it easy to find.

hierarchy.location: right-side participation and fee/invitation groups
hierarchy.observation: The group boundaries survive reduction. The vertically spaced blocks give a calm reading sequence, although the stitched boundary and free-positioned blocks make the path less emphatic than M2.

typography.location: top headline and event subtitle
typography.observation: The dark serif title has intact Hangul and deliberate broad tracking; the bold sans subtitle has clear middle-dot punctuation. These are purposeful different type roles.

typography.location: middle-right logistics, participation lines and lower-right invitation
typography.observation: All required text is readable against the cream weave. Date dots, time dash and bring-items comma are distinct. Broad title tracking is looser than the compact supporting type, without changing the word reading.

space.location: stitched diagonal and cream text field on the right
space.observation: The seam cuts diagonally through the poster while every text block sits on the lighter cloth. Text preserves a buffer around the ragged join and the patch; the large cream intervals provide deliberate calm.

space.location: right-side separate logistics, activity and invitation groups
space.observation: Block spacing is generous and the outer-right margins are stable enough to contain the type. The different block widths and loose vertical gaps are functional, but lack the tighter picture/text interlock of M1.

image_material.location: cream and terracotta cloth surfaces, frayed join
image_material.observation: Weave, folds, fraying and thread thickness are distinguishable. The visible joining stitches transform the material from backdrop texture into substantive repaired fabric.

image_material.location: small square patch in lower-left/center
image_material.observation: The patch has its own orientation, frayed edge and surrounding stitches. Stitch irregularity is plausible for visible mending, although some congested thread clusters reduce local clarity.

emotion_control.location: warm terracotta cloth, cream field and dark title
emotion_control.observation: Soft fabric and warm colors communicate patience and care, fitting the unhurried invitation and neighborhood repair activity.

emotion_control.location: visibly imperfect seam and patch
emotion_control.observation: The retained wear is approachable rather than immaculate or intimidating. The emotional effect is calm and tactile; the poster supplies less social warmth through its image than M5.

ai_slop.observation: The visual vocabulary is limited to cloth and visible repairs; there are no floating craft icons, unrelated flourishes, extra lettering, logos or watermarks.

ai_slop.location: seam threads and square patch stitches
ai_slop.observation: Thread repetition follows the actual cloth boundaries and patch. Dense tangles occur at frayed areas, but the main construction remains intelligible instead of becoming an arbitrary texture field.

residuals: The image directly communicates repair; the exchange subject is carried by the supplied copy.
Separated right-side groups and generous gaps are clear but less tightly integrated with the image than M1.
R8-C1-M3.assessment: A cream and terracotta textile construction turns visible repair into the dominant image. The hierarchy is calm and usable; exchange is communicated chiefly by the supplied wording.

hierarchy.location: top-left logistics and blue-backed middle-right bring-items block
hierarchy.observation: Date/time/venue are conspicuous at the top, and the blue-backed instruction stands out among the objects. This is a usable practical reading sequence.

hierarchy.location: bottom oversized title, event and blue fee line
hierarchy.observation: The very large bottom title provides a clear finish and the fee is easy to find. The event category sits low and competes with the adjacent fee, so recognition is less immediate than M2 despite remaining clear.

typography.location: bottom title and event/fee row
typography.observation: Intact heavy Hangul and strong contrast preserve the supplied title, event name and fee. The tall blue vertical separator is a graphic rule, not an added copy entry.

typography.location: top-left date/time/place, middle instruction and bottom invitation
typography.observation: All required copy is readable. The instruction wraps after the comma without losing a word; the small invitation is isolated below. The near-full-width bold title and activity line have relatively tight outer margins.

space.location: four object areas and central instruction zone
space.observation: A book occupies the left upper field, a shirt the upper-right crop, and a mug and bag the lower image field. Copy uses the remaining white gaps with no overlap onto the detailed objects.

space.location: shirt-to-blue-panel gap and bottom title region
space.observation: The narrow white gap under the shirt distinguishes it from the instruction panel. The bottom title is dense and extends close to both sides, but the invitation below has breathing room; the grid is resolved rather than exceptionally refined.

image_material.location: book cover, ceramic mug and bag hardware
image_material.observation: Worn cover cloth, glazed ceramic and textured bag fabric have distinct surfaces. Object edges remain clean on the opaque cream field, while the strap and buckle are recognizable.

image_material.location: shirt patch and shoulder repair
image_material.observation: The shirt weave, pocket, buttons and stitches form a coherent object. The oversized pale stitches are somewhat stiff compared with the otherwise photographic cloth detail, which limits fine material refinement.

emotion_control.location: used household objects in warm and cool colors
emotion_control.observation: The familiar book, cup, bag and shirt make the event approachable without specialist tools. The ochre, red and olive objects soften the large black type.

emotion_control.location: blue-backed bring-items line and lower invitation
emotion_control.observation: Concrete instructions and the conspicuous fee make participation feel practical and accessible. The overall mood is direct and catalogue-like, less interpersonal than M1 and M5.

ai_slop.observation: Every large item relates to repair or everyday exchange. There are no unrelated filler illustrations, invented labels, logos or watermarks on the objects.

ai_slop.location: bag strap/buckle, cup handle and shirt repair stitches
ai_slop.observation: The main functional structures remain legible. The stiff enlarged stitching is the weakest local construction, but does not prevent recognizing a repaired shirt or create a contradictory item.

residuals: The bottom title and event/fee row are dense and the event category is encountered later than the upper logistics.
Oversized pale shirt stitches feel stiffer than the other photographic material details.
R8-C1-M4.assessment: A cutout object catalogue combines a patched shirt, worn book, mug and shoulder bag with conspicuous practical instructions. Its dense bottom title and mixed object scales are effective but less refined than the strongest spatial treatment in the set.

content_form.location: top-right panel, seated woman sewing with an attentive neighbor
content_form.observation: The scene explicitly represents shared mending and a person observing how it is done, giving a first-time visitor a concrete picture of the gathering.

content_form.location: middle-left close sewing panel and bottom-right ceramic handover panel
content_form.observation: The close view explains the repair activity; the lower handover provides an equally substantial exchange activity among everyday goods. The alternating panels and neighboring copy explain both actions exceptionally specifically.

hierarchy.location: top-left title/subtitle/logistics beside first scene
hierarchy.observation: The large brush title starts the sequence, followed by the event category and readable date/time/place. The neighboring social scene attracts attention without covering this information.

hierarchy.location: three alternating panel/text pairs
hierarchy.observation: The zigzag sequence and large participation/fee/invitation blocks remain distinct. Logistics and the activity line become the smallest type at this size, so the thumbnail is chiefly a scene-and-headline view; usage720 retains full information.

typography.location: brush title, right-side participation block and lower-left fee/invitation
typography.observation: Rounded brush Hangul is consistent across the large display lines and fits the friendly illustration. Required words remain intact; wrapping is confined to the title and bring-items instruction.

typography.location: left logistics and mid-right small activity line
typography.observation: The smaller dark type remains readable on cream, with clear date dots, time dash and middle dots. The narrow logistics column and small activity line have less visual authority than the display lettering, limiting typography to strong rather than exceptional.

space.location: alternating three bordered image panels and cream text regions
space.observation: Text and picture trade sides across the page, with consistent dark panel boundaries and open cream gutters. The top title/logistics and two later instruction areas each have a dedicated region.

space.location: middle-right two-line instruction and lower-left fee/invitation
space.observation: The large text blocks sit within their gutters and the thin gold rules separate their roles. Margins are controlled, although the middle small activity line uses almost all of its available width.

image_material.location: middle-left sewing panel: needle, thread, cloth, scissors and pin cushion
image_material.observation: The sewing action is identifiable, the scissors have distinct blades and handles, and the cloth has consistent folds. The long light needle/thread marks and small stitches remain a little schematic at close inspection.

image_material.location: bottom-right exchange panel, ceramic jug and supporting hands
image_material.observation: Hands visibly approach the jug at its handle and base; the folded shirt, books and basket are separately constructed. Brown contours and warm shading stay consistent across the scenes, while facial/room details are more conventional than the specific action design.

emotion_control.location: top-right faces and body language during mending
emotion_control.observation: The neighbor watches with a relaxed chin-in-hand posture and a gentle expression while the repairer works. This specifically lowers the barrier for someone who is curious and inexperienced, rather than merely adding smiling faces.

emotion_control.location: bottom-right handover and visible background visitor
emotion_control.observation: Mutual smiles, carefully supported everyday goods and another person in the room make exchange communal and unhurried. The same attentive emotional register connects the three scenes and the invitation with exceptional specificity.

ai_slop.observation: Each panel has a distinct explanatory role: shared repair, closer repair detail, exchange. Repeated shirt/tool motifs provide visible continuity and do not become unrelated ornamental filler.

Potted plants and room furnishings are conventional scene dressing, and small needle/thread details are simplified. They stay subordinate to intelligible actions; no stray text, logos or watermark is visible. This is coherent professional execution, not the most singular local rendering in the set.

residuals: Date/time/place and the activity line have less typographic prominence than the display instructions; they remain readable at usage720.
Small sewing marks and conventional background props limit close-detail originality and refinement.
R8-C1-M5.assessment: Three illustrated panels show shared mending, a close view of sewing and a ceramic handover. The scenes and the copy form a specific, welcoming explanation for a first-time visitor; small local rendering details remain less exceptional than the narrative and emotional control.

content_form.location: upper-left quarter, hands and frayed striped cuff
content_form.observation: Two cropped hands hold the frayed garment at a visible needle/thread area; the repair subject is an action rather than an unrelated craft symbol.

content_form.location: lower-right half, worn book between two hands
content_form.observation: Hands approach the book from opposite edges, making a transfer legible alongside the repair. Wear on the cover connects both subjects to using things again.

hierarchy.location: middle-left orange title, upper-right black event/logistics, lower-left instructions
hierarchy.observation: The orange two-line title is the principal type focal point; event/date/time/place are grouped together above, and bring-items/activity/fee/invitation are grouped below without crossing the image actions.

hierarchy.location: whole poster
hierarchy.observation: The orange title and two hand/object clusters remain distinct. The event/logistics are smaller but remain a single identifiable block; the practical copy is less prominent than at usage size.

typography.location: orange title at middle-left and black logistics at upper-right
typography.observation: Clean Hangul strokes, a deliberate two-line title and clear date dots/time colons coexist with strong color contrast. Wide title tracking is controlled, though less optically compact than the body.

typography.location: upper-right logistics and lower-left four-line participation block
typography.observation: All required copy is readable at this size. The comma, middle dot and time dash are visible; the lower block has enough separation for each line to be read independently.

space.location: open tabletop between the upper-left repair and lower-right book
space.observation: The two cropped actions create a diagonal field of actual tabletop. Three text blocks occupy its different clear regions, preserving the active hands and balancing both occupied corners without a separate box.

space.location: title at left center and thread loop above it
space.observation: The title sits below the thread loop with a generous buffer; the blank region is part of the picture and connects the opposing actions. This is exceptionally specific spatial integration, rather than leftover background.

image_material.location: upper-left garment edge, thread, hands and button
image_material.observation: Frayed warp threads, the striped weave, skin creases and button are locally differentiated, under consistent soft light. The loose thread remains visibly separate from the cuff.

image_material.location: lower-right worn book and hands
image_material.observation: Cover scuffs, cloth-like surface, spine and uneven page edges have coherent detail; the hands hold recognizable edges. The monochrome photographic construction is strong, with dense thread tangles limiting absolute close-detail clarity.

emotion_control.location: whole photograph with orange title and invitation
emotion_control.observation: The close hands and used objects make the event personal and unhurried. The orange invitation adds warmth to the restrained grayscale rather than relying on an unrelated cheerful motif.

emotion_control.location: cropped participants at top-left and bottom-right
emotion_control.observation: People are represented through ordinary cooperative actions. The gentle lighting and worn materials communicate care, although the monochrome mood is quieter than M2 or M5.

ai_slop.observation: The major image elements have clear task roles. There are no unrelated decorative symbols, additional words, logos or watermarks; the book and garment do not acquire arbitrary inscriptions.

ai_slop.location: upper-left frayed seam and loose thread
ai_slop.observation: The fraying is densely tangled, but is confined to the damaged garment and the thread path. It does not contradict the visible repair action; local clarity is strong rather than exceptional.

residuals: Wide title tracking loses some word compactness at thumbnail size; the lower participation group is quieter than the main title/logistics.
The densely frayed sewing area is less locally clear than the worn book, though the action remains legible.
raw.assessment: A restrained documentary composition uses cropped hands, a frayed shirt and a worn book to make repair and exchange tangible. The open tabletop accommodates the copy with unusually good spatial integration.

content_form.location: lower diagonal, patched folded sweater between two hands
content_form.observation: The stitched patch and folded garment add the clothing-repair subject. The two exchanges organize the main event band rather than functioning as small corner ornaments.

hierarchy.location: large white central event name and top-left logistics
hierarchy.observation: The event category remains the largest single message at thumbnail size. Date, time and venue remain a compact group in the upper white wedge, making the practical public-event function immediately recognizable.

hierarchy.location: lower-right bring-items/activity block and lower-left fee/invitation
hierarchy.observation: The two-line bring-items instruction is prominent; the activity line is clearly subordinate, while the fee and invitation receive a separate, readily found position. Several supporting blocks remain emphatically bold.

typography.location: central white event name on cobalt field
typography.observation: The very large Hangul stays within the edges and reads as one coherent line, with visible middle-dot punctuation. The blue/white contrast preserves it through reduction.

typography.location: upper-left title/logistics and lower-right instruction heading
typography.observation: All required words and punctuation are intact. Heavy type suits the public notice but offers limited weight contrast, and some pale edge offsets around the bold lettering keep the finish below exceptional refinement.

space.location: blue diagonal bands separating white wedges
space.observation: The book and sweater cross into the bands while text occupies the remaining wedges. The central headline has its own continuous blue field and does not collide with either object.

space.location: bottom-left fee/invitation and bottom-right instruction block
space.observation: Both blocks have usable outer margins. The right instruction block is relatively close to the sweater above and the lower-right edge, but remains contained and legible.

image_material.location: upper book illustration and hands
image_material.observation: White page edges, blue cover planes and navy contours make a convincing simplified book; the hands and cuffs share the same line and fill language.

image_material.location: lower sweater collar, patch, folded layers and hands
image_material.observation: White dashes differentiate stitching from the continuous dark contour. The folded layers remain readable, although the rounded stacked folds are schematic rather than exceptionally precise.

emotion_control.location: opposing hands and central blue event band
emotion_control.observation: The cooperative gestures communicate participation without an intimidating specialist scene. Vivid blue and large welcoming words give the event energy and accessibility.

emotion_control.location: patched sweater and lower-left invitation
emotion_control.observation: The repair detail and explicit friendly invitation keep the assertive graphic style tied to a neighborhood activity. Its emotional range is energetic and practical, less intimate than M1 or M5.

ai_slop.observation: The two large object transfers have distinct content roles. There is no random icon filler, fabricated branding or extra copy; color and contours stay within a coherent small vocabulary.

ai_slop.location: book pages, sweater stitch paths and cuff marks
ai_slop.observation: Repeated page lines, cuff stripes and stitch marks attach to identifiable objects. The schematic details do not become floating decoration or contradictory objects.

residuals: Several supporting blocks use similarly heavy type, reducing subtle rank differentiation.
Pale offsets around some native bold type edges and schematic sweater folds limit exceptional finish.
raw.assessment: A vivid blue illustration places two object handovers across strong diagonals and makes the event name the central public-facing headline. Information is direct and emphatic, with some heavy supporting type.

hierarchy.location: top headline/subtitle and right-side logistics
hierarchy.observation: The serif headline and smaller bold event line establish a clear opening; the three-line date/time/venue group is isolated below, making it easy to find.

hierarchy.location: right-side participation and fee/invitation groups
hierarchy.observation: The group boundaries survive reduction. The vertically spaced blocks give a calm reading sequence, although the stitched boundary and free-positioned blocks make the path less emphatic than M2.

typography.location: top headline and event subtitle
typography.observation: The dark serif title has intact Hangul and deliberate broad tracking; the bold sans subtitle has clear middle-dot punctuation. These are purposeful different type roles.

typography.location: middle-right logistics, participation lines and lower-right invitation
typography.observation: All required text is readable against the cream weave. Date dots, time dash and bring-items comma are distinct. Broad title tracking is looser than the compact supporting type, without changing the word reading.

space.location: stitched diagonal and cream text field on the right
space.observation: The seam cuts diagonally through the poster while every text block sits on the lighter cloth. Text preserves a buffer around the ragged join and the patch; the large cream intervals provide deliberate calm.

space.location: right-side separate logistics, activity and invitation groups
space.observation: Block spacing is generous and the outer-right margins are stable enough to contain the type. The different block widths and loose vertical gaps are functional, but lack the tighter picture/text interlock of M1.

image_material.location: cream and terracotta cloth surfaces, frayed join
image_material.observation: Weave, folds, fraying and thread thickness are distinguishable. The visible joining stitches transform the material from backdrop texture into substantive repaired fabric.

image_material.location: small square patch in lower-left/center
image_material.observation: The patch has its own orientation, frayed edge and surrounding stitches. Stitch irregularity is plausible for visible mending, although some congested thread clusters reduce local clarity.

emotion_control.location: warm terracotta cloth, cream field and dark title
emotion_control.observation: Soft fabric and warm colors communicate patience and care, fitting the unhurried invitation and neighborhood repair activity.

emotion_control.location: visibly imperfect seam and patch
emotion_control.observation: The retained wear is approachable rather than immaculate or intimidating. The emotional effect is calm and tactile; the poster supplies less social warmth through its image than M5.

ai_slop.observation: The visual vocabulary is limited to cloth and visible repairs; there are no floating craft icons, unrelated flourishes, extra lettering, logos or watermarks.

ai_slop.location: seam threads and square patch stitches
ai_slop.observation: Thread repetition follows the actual cloth boundaries and patch. Dense tangles occur at frayed areas, but the main construction remains intelligible instead of becoming an arbitrary texture field.

residuals: The image directly communicates repair; the exchange subject is carried by the supplied copy.
Separated right-side groups and generous gaps are clear but less tightly integrated with the image than M1.
raw.assessment: A cream and terracotta textile construction turns visible repair into the dominant image. The hierarchy is calm and usable; exchange is communicated chiefly by the supplied wording.

content_form.location: upper-right blue shirt with sewn patch and shoulder stitches
content_form.observation: The repaired shirt makes clothing repair concrete, and is large enough to read as an actual item rather than an ornamental icon.

content_form.location: left worn book and mug, lower-right green shoulder bag
content_form.observation: Different everyday items visibly broaden the exchange subject beyond clothing. Their wear and practical forms support the request to bring objects back into use.

hierarchy.location: top-left logistics and blue-backed middle-right bring-items block
hierarchy.observation: Date/time/venue are conspicuous at the top, and the blue-backed instruction stands out among the objects. This is a usable practical reading sequence.

hierarchy.location: bottom oversized title, event and blue fee line
hierarchy.observation: The very large bottom title provides a clear finish and the fee is easy to find. The event category sits low and competes with the adjacent fee, so recognition is less immediate than M2 despite remaining clear.

typography.location: bottom title and event/fee row
typography.observation: Intact heavy Hangul and strong contrast preserve the supplied title, event name and fee. The tall blue vertical separator is a graphic rule, not an added copy entry.

typography.location: top-left date/time/place, middle instruction and bottom invitation
typography.observation: All required copy is readable. The instruction wraps after the comma without losing a word; the small invitation is isolated below. The near-full-width bold title and activity line have relatively tight outer margins.

space.location: four object areas and central instruction zone
space.observation: A book occupies the left upper field, a shirt the upper-right crop, and a mug and bag the lower image field. Copy uses the remaining white gaps with no overlap onto the detailed objects.

space.location: shirt-to-blue-panel gap and bottom title region
space.observation: The narrow white gap under the shirt distinguishes it from the instruction panel. The bottom title is dense and extends close to both sides, but the invitation below has breathing room; the grid is resolved rather than exceptionally refined.

image_material.location: book cover, ceramic mug and bag hardware
image_material.observation: Worn cover cloth, glazed ceramic and textured bag fabric have distinct surfaces. Object edges remain clean on the opaque cream field, while the strap and buckle are recognizable.

image_material.location: shirt patch and shoulder repair
image_material.observation: The shirt weave, pocket, buttons and stitches form a coherent object. The oversized pale stitches are somewhat stiff compared with the otherwise photographic cloth detail, which limits fine material refinement.

emotion_control.location: used household objects in warm and cool colors
emotion_control.observation: The familiar book, cup, bag and shirt make the event approachable without specialist tools. The ochre, red and olive objects soften the large black type.

emotion_control.location: blue-backed bring-items line and lower invitation
emotion_control.observation: Concrete instructions and the conspicuous fee make participation feel practical and accessible. The overall mood is direct and catalogue-like, less interpersonal than M1 and M5.

ai_slop.observation: Every large item relates to repair or everyday exchange. There are no unrelated filler illustrations, invented labels, logos or watermarks on the objects.

ai_slop.location: bag strap/buckle, cup handle and shirt repair stitches
ai_slop.observation: The main functional structures remain legible. The stiff enlarged stitching is the weakest local construction, but does not prevent recognizing a repaired shirt or create a contradictory item.

residuals: The bottom title and event/fee row are dense and the event category is encountered later than the upper logistics.
Oversized pale shirt stitches feel stiffer than the other photographic material details.
raw.assessment: A cutout object catalogue combines a patched shirt, worn book, mug and shoulder bag with conspicuous practical instructions. Its dense bottom title and mixed object scales are effective but less refined than the strongest spatial treatment in the set.

procedure.method: Independent fresh assessment. Verified byte counts and SHA-256 of the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, helper scripts, five selected manifests and all fifteen poster files. The packet has no source assets or protected layouts. Viewed the exact files through tools.view_image({path,detail:'original'}), emitting the returned image with original detail. Five successive functions.exec calls each awaited native, usage720, then thumbnail320 for M1 through M5 in packet order; I visually inspected the displayed results. All fifteen initial views were completed before recording first raw copy transcriptions, assigning any image score or judging set diversity. No contact sheet, OCR, image transformation, revisit, peer review, author explanation, unpinned embedded path or session ID was used. PNG IHDR reads independently confirmed dimensions and opaque RGB color type 2; those reads did not replace visual inspection.
